evidence.summary: The generic launcher admitted a repository-owned descriptor and returned a typed ApplicationExit with bounded process-boundary data.
Actions-owned descriptors declare native application identity, entrypoint, profile, libraries, and explicit artifact capabilities.

reproduction.instructions: re-run the originating Phase IV canary recorded by this observation

summary: The generic run-app launcher and repository-owned application descriptors now pass bounded argv, environment, cwd, stdin, and capability authority to an MNCS entrypoint. Actions has descriptors and canaries, but its normal selected-family CLI remains the compatibility launcher.
